_about: PC-only deviations from the canonical Fire/Air numbers (docs/design/reconciled/data/arena/spells-*.csv and schools-combat.json, which carry VR's numbers). Keys: '<spellId>.<column>' (castS, cooldownS, mana, damage, telegraphS, rangeM) or '<school>.identity.<dotted key>'. Unknown keys fail at load. Parity suites run with ArenaState.balance = 'canonical', which ignores this file. Every key is a deviation and a CR candidate for VR (docs/concepts/W8-fire-air-dual-channel.md section 8). W8 lane B (2026-10-23): darts cut to the damage a VR seated dome lets through (PC has no dome) and halved in mana so the rivals can afford their kit; Air Form made free and quick, the one defensive row either rival plays (its reaction wards cover only the few threats seen longer than its reaction delay). W8 lane X (2026-10-23): AI reaction now runs at pace, so the rivals ward again; every key re-checked against the reacting AI and Lio's dart re-cut 1.1 -> 0.9 to bring the final's win rate back into range. Evidence: docs/waves/W8-evidence/named.json.
